title: Aftergraph Platform Topology
description: Slow-changing canonical repository/topology source for the Aftergraph polyrepo platform. Separates the seven permanent semantic architecture_plane values from the extensible system_class. Defines scope and ownership classes, never exact Git state (exact heads are generated from GitHub by scripts/org-state-verify.sh into org-state/1.0 snapshots). platform-topology/1.0 remains readable for historical provenance; new active Governance code consumes platform-topology/2.0.

evidence_cut.description: ISO-8601 calendar date of the last reviewed topology cut.

name.description: Repository short name within the Aftergraph organization.

canonical_branch.description: Canonical branch as reconciled against the GitHub default branch.

architecture_plane.description: One of the seven permanent semantic planes, or null for support systems that must not fake a plane.

system_class.description: Functional repository class (governance, continuity, assurance, models, legacy-transition, ...). Never inferred into an architecture plane.

role.description: Current ownership role; must match the dependencies.yml projection for the same repository.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle state such as active, temporary, internal-hold or legacy-transition.

owns.description: Canonical responsibility owned by this repository.

must_not_own.description: Explicit non-ownership boundary; appearing in topology never grants this.
